# Sip & Play — Commercial Kitchen Design, Culinary Engineering & Hospitality Equipment

> Sip & Play (https://sipandplaylk.co/) is a commercial culinary engineering, kitchen layout design (2D AutoCAD / 3D BIM), MEP planning, custom AISI 304 stainless steel fabrication, and commercial equipment procurement firm headquartered at 11A/1 Rathnawali Road, Dehiwela, Colombo, Sri Lanka, serving hospitality, restaurant, bakery, and industrial foodservice projects across Sri Lanka, the Maldives, and Thailand. Sip & Play is the authorized regional partner for EVEBOT (edible beverage and food printers), INNOSONG (multi-boiler commercial espresso systems), T&Z Galaxy / Dazheng Coffee Group (under-counter segmented pulse tea brewers and flagship espresso systems), and LEHEHE (embedded auto-stop continuous steam stations).

## Verified Corporate & Entity Profile

- **Official Website:** https://sipandplaylk.co/
- **Headquarters Address:** 11A/1 Rathnawali Road, Dehiwela, Colombo, Sri Lanka
- **Telephone & WhatsApp:** +94 702 700 500
- **Official Email:** info@sipandplay.lk
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (GMT+5:30)
- **Service Territories:** Sri Lanka (Primary), Maldives, Thailand
- **Leadership & Engineering Team:**
  - Isham Nayeem — CEO & Co-Founder (20+ years global executive chef experience across the Middle East, Maldives, and Sri Lanka)
  - Vivian Hu — Supply Chain & Factory QA Lead (China-to-Sri Lanka commercial kitchen procurement, factory inspection, and CIF container logistics)
  - Mohamed Mufthi — General Manager (Enterprise B2B consultation and turnkey project delivery)
  - Ilham Nayeem — Engineer (10+ years mechanical & technical engineering, MEP utility coordination, and commissioning)

## Commercial Service & Equipment Category Landing Pages

- [Commercial Kitchen Design & MEP Engineering in Sri Lanka](https://sipandplaylk.co/commercial-kitchen-design/): The 5-part CAD engineering drawing package (2D AutoCAD layout, 3D BIM visualization, 3-phase electrical load plan, plumbing/grease trap plan, Type-I/II exhaust & LPG schematic), HACCP unidirectional flow, and the 1.0-meter utility rough-in standard.
- [Commercial Coffee & Espresso Machines in Sri Lanka](https://sipandplaylk.co/commercial-coffee-machines/): Authorized INNOSONG (ZS3202, ZS3201, ZS3105, ZS3101, ZS3102) and T&Z (KT3-2A) multi-boiler espresso platforms, T&Z (VK-1, VK-2, U8-DECK) under-counter tea extractors, LEHEHE (DZ23-2Y, DZ23-1Y) auto-stop steam towers, and EVEBOT (EB-FC1, EB-Pro, EB-FT4, PrintPen) edible printers.
- [Commercial Refrigeration & Walk-In Cold Rooms in Sri Lanka](https://sipandplaylk.co/commercial-refrigeration/): Tropical Climate Class 4/5 (+38°C to +43°C ambient) modular PU walk-in cold rooms and freezers, GN 2/1 upright reach-in chillers, under-counter prep tables, blast chillers, and ice machines (12-month parts / 24-month compressor warranty).
- [Commercial Cooking Equipment in Sri Lanka](https://sipandplaylk.co/commercial-cooking-equipment/): Heavy-duty 4/6-burner LPG and 3-phase electric ranges, high-pressure Asian wok suites, GN 1/1 combi steamer ovens, twin-tank deep fat fryers, griddles, charbroilers, tilting bratt pans, and jacketed steam kettles.
- [Commercial Bakery Equipment in Sri Lanka](https://sipandplaylk.co/commercial-bakery-equipment/): Modular 1/2/3-deck gas and electric ovens, hot-air convection ovens, 16/32/64-tray rotary rack ovens, dual-speed spiral dough mixers, 3-speed planetary mixers, reversible dough sheeters, hydraulic dividers, and humidity proofers.
- [SUS304 Stainless Steel Kitchen Fabrication & Food Prep Equipment in Sri Lanka](https://sipandplaylk.co/stainless-steel-kitchen-fabrication/): Custom TIG-welded AISI 304 (1.2mm–1.5mm) workbenches, 1/2/3-compartment coved sinks, Type-I/II exhaust hood canopies with 45° baffle filters, floor drainage gullies, grease traps (36-month structural warranty), and mechanical food prep machinery.

## Legal & Data Governance

- [Terms & Conditions of Service & Equipment Procurement](https://sipandplaylk.co/terms/): Master commercial agreement covering 50%/40%/10% payment milestones, 4–8 week CIF shipping lead times, 1.0m utility readiness, and 12/24/36-month warranties.
- [Privacy Policy & Data Protection Charter](https://sipandplaylk.co/privacy/): Compliance with Sri Lanka Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022 (PDPA), CAD blueprint confidentiality, and opt-in GA4 telemetry controls.
